newsitem.title: BULGARIA: NO CORPORATE STOCKS TRADE ON BULGARIA BOURSES.
newsitem.headline: NO CORPORATE STOCKS TRADE ON BULGARIA BOURSES.

text.p: The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Tuesday's 41.02 points as no corporate stocks traded on Bulgarian bourses for a third day in a row, brokers said.
One seven-day repo deal in treasury paper worth of 1.471 million levs was struck on the Sofia Stock Exchange. The paper yields 4.96 percent until repurchase.
No repo deals were struck on Bulgarian exchanges on Tuesday.
